row:
This channel is dedicated to supporting children's  movement, strength, balance, and functional independence through evidence-based pediatric physiotherapy. You will find practical therapy ideas, exercises, activity progressions, parent and caregiver guidance, and professional insights designed to support children with diverse developmental and physical needs. Whether you are a parent ,caregiver, therapist, or educator, this channel aims to make pediatric physiotherapy simple, engaging and meaningful - helping every child move with confidence and joy. 😊



 #ChildDevelopment #PediatricPT #NeuroPhysiotherapy #MotorDevelopment  #PhysiotherapyForChildren #ParentEducation #SpecialNeedsParenting #childcenteredcare #facilitationtechniques
